reuse.why: Reuses recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule and getDateWithSkippedWeekend, mirroring getUpcomingDates.

duplication.why: Copies getUpcomingDates' skipDaily computation, weekend filter and conditional getDateWithSkippedWeekend mapping instead of extracting a shared 'final schedule day' function; the daily rule now lives in three places.

placement.why: The handler sits next to getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts and is registered like it, though the occurrence-to-final-day rule would belong in shared/schedules.ts.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its registration and tests.

maintainability.why: Readable and typed, but another copy of the weekend/daily rule must be kept in sync with getNextDate and getUpcomingDates; the hard-coded 3-day padding is tied to the current rule.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses the existing weekend helper getDateWithSkippedWeekend; no shared daily-skip abstraction existed to bypass.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied skipDaily block is recognisably the same as in getUpcomingDates (forEach instead of filter/map, but not disguised beyond that).
